# NFL Daily — 2026-11-24 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Packers EDGE Micah Parsons activated off PUP and cleared to make his 2026 season debut Wednesday night against the Rams. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50577301/sources-packers-micah-parsons-cleared-return-wednesday)
- 49ers released WR Brandon Aiyuk, ending his tumultuous tenure with the team. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575346/sources-49ers-releasing-wr-brandon-aiyuk)
- Cardinals fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis; Rick Austin takes over on an interim basis. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575938/cardinals-fire-defensive-coordinator-nick-rallis-sources-say)
- 49ers locked up GM John Lynch with a multiyear contract extension. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/49ers-gm-john-lynch-has-agreed-to-a-longterm-contract-extension-ap-source-says)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown (hamstring) is doubtful after not practicing Tuesday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (quad/rib) is questionable but trending to start Sunday at San Francisco if he clears Wednesday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Giants CB Greg Newsome II is out the next 4-6 weeks after ankle surgery in Week 12. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 49ers OT Colton McKivitz is out with a fractured, dislocated left ankle suffered Sunday vs. the Vikings. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-24 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens waived WR/returner LaJohntay Wester and QB Kedon Slovis; Wester was cut after muffing two punts (losing one) in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-waive-lajohntay-wester-kedon-slovis-returner-quarterback)
- CB Marlon Humphrey has rejoined the team at the facility; Jesse Minter says no decision has been made on his status for Sunday's game vs. the Texans. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-marlon-humphrey-update-tj-tampa-highest-defensive-grade-carolina-panthers-minter-two-minute-blunders)
- The Ravens are the NFL's only team ranked top-five in both most penalties (85) and worst turnover differential (minus-7) this season. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2125257380669628697)

# Rivals — 2026-11-24 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Bengals' five-game win streak was snapped in a 22-20 MNF loss to the Commanders, with officiating under scrutiny after reports the clock was missing two seconds on the game-deciding field goal. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7808248/2026/11/24/bengals-should-have-had-2-more-seconds-after-commanders-go-ahead-field-goal/)
- Steelers WR DK Metcalf will not be suspended for his ejection in Sunday's loss to the Eagles, though the NFL is still weighing a possible fine. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/steelers-star-wr-dk-metcalf-avoids-suspension-after-being-ejected-in-loss-to-eagles.html)
- Steelers coach Mike McCarthy reaffirmed Aaron Rodgers as the starting QB despite his struggles, ruling out a change. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/mike-mccarthy-wont-make-big-change-for-steelers-at-qb-aaron-rodgers-is-our-quarterback.html)
